description: Synthetic text-only Jan redaction policy cases. No participant data. Expected spans require complete sensitive-character coverage at every occurrence unless occurrence (zero-based) is specified. Retain assertions refer to original offsets, so another surviving copy cannot hide over-redaction. Separate date components may be replaced together. PHOTO/BIOMETRIC cases cover explicitly labeled textual representations only, not pixels, audio, files, or legal compliance.
policy: Jan September 28 proposal: 18 labels; retain ordinary individual-date years; ages 90+ under DATES; remove whole ZIP codes; text input only
